Md. Mamun Hasan @ Md. Mamun Hossain
Vs.
The State
full_judgment:
Md. Nuruzzaman, J: This Rule was issued calling upon the Deputy Commissioner, Narayangonj to show cause as to why the accused petitioner should not be enlarged on bail in G.R. No. 343 of 2013 arising out of Narayangonj Shodor Model Police Station Case No. 11 dated 14.12.2013, under Sections 302/201/109/34 of the Penal Code, 1860 now pending in the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Narayangonj. 

 2. The prosecution case in short, is that, informant Seema Akter, wife of deceased Abdul Jalil lodged an ejahar with Narayangonj Model Seder Police, alleging, inter-alia, that accused Kamruzzam Dhali, Bilai Khokan, Md. Mamun Hasan, Md. Shaft, Ashraful Haque, Ahmed Mia, Mohammad Amin and unknown 7/8 miscreants killed her husband. Her husband deceased Abdul Jalil is a simple businessman. He has 12 decimals of land adjacent to his homestead and there was a dispute with accused persons regarding the said land. The accused persons tried to grab the said land. Her husband filed a case in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Second Court, Narayangonj to get a permanent injunction against them for this reason the accused persons became furious and threatened to kill her husband and his family members. To save the life her husband and family members filed another case on 10.12.2013 in the Court of learned Magistrate, 2nd Court, Narahangonj under Sections 107/114/117 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. On the same day the went out from house at 4.30 p.m. to do a salish in business transaction with Mamun Hasan and hoisted a sign board in his possessing land. But he did not return after a long period of time awaiting for him. Later on, she has been heard a dead body was found in a gunny bag near kadam 'tale bridge of Al-Amin Nagar. She went there with her relatives and recovered the dead body of her husband. After consultation with the witnesses and relatives there is a delay in lodging the F.I.R. 

 3. Mr. Taimur Alam Khondoker, the learned Advocate appearing for the accused-petitioner submits that the accused petitioner voluntarily surrendered before the High Court Division with a prayer for anticipatory bail. The High Court Division enlarged the accused petitioner on anticipatory bail on 17.09.2014 in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 42558 of 2014. Thereafter upon expiry of the period of anticipatory bail the accused petitioner surrendered voluntarily before the learned Sessions Judge, Narayangonj in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2919 of 2014 with a prayer for bail and learned Judge by his order dated 28.10.2014 rejected the prayer for bail and accused petitioner was taken into the custody. Since then the accused petitioner has been languishing in the jail custody. He further submits that as per F.I.R. the date of occurrence was on 10.12.2013 to 14.12.2013. The informant neither an eye witness of the occurrence nor she heard the facts of occurrence from any eye witness though she has given a story in the F.I.R. without mentioning the phone number of anybody, therefore, the said fact of F.I.R. mentioned by the informant has no substance. He further submits that the accused petitioner is a law abiding citizen and in any way involved with the alleged occurrence. The co-accused Ashraful Haque and Raju of the case were granted bail by this Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 786 of 2014 and 33286 of 2014. He also pointed out that till today the investigation of the case not yet concluded. Therefore, it is quite uncertain as to when the investigation of the case would be concluded and trial would be concluded. 'Therefore, be prays for making the Rule absolute and thereby enlarged the accused petitioner on bail. 

 5. We have gone through the First Information Report and other materials available on records and on perusal of the seine it reveals that the accused petitioner was granted anticipatory bail from this Court and on expiry of the same he has voluntarily surrendered before the Sessions Court without misusing the privilege of bail on 28.10.2014 and he was taken into custody. On perusal of the F.I.R. narrative it appears that there is a land dispute among the deceased and accused persons, though in the F.I.R. it has been alleged that the accused called the deceased on phone but in the F.I.R. there is no iota of word that after disappearance of the deceased the informant or her relative suspected the accused petitioner or he asked him about the whereabouts of the accused. Further more there is no allegation in the F.I.R. that they have made the G.D. Entry against this accused petitioner. On perusal of the records it further reveals that the case is still under investigation. So it is crystal clear that there is no certainty as to when the investigation would be concluded and trial would be commenced. In the facts and circumstances of the case we find substances in the Rule. Therefore, we are inclined to enlarge the accused-petitioner on bail. 

 7. Let the accused-petitioner Md. Mamun Hassan @ Md. Mamun Hossain, Son of late Fazal Huq be enlarged on bail in G.R. No. 343 of 2013 arising out of Narayangonj Shodor Model Police Station Case No. 11 dated 14.12.2013, under Sections 302/201/109/34 of the Penal Code, 1860 now pending in the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Narayangonj on furnishing bail bond to the satisfaction of the aforesaid Court till disposal of the aforementioned case.
